evidence.note: Reviewed the full v4 sharding rewrite: budget normalization happens before chunksOf, so the chunk loop cannot spin on a zero budget; chunksOf always advances (hard cut when no newline is in range) and every emitted chunk is <= budget, so the PlanShards flush loop cannot emit an over-budget shard; hashes (chunk/shard/plan/source) are order-normalized by sorted (Path, Part) before hashing, so identity is stable.

Reviewed runs.jsonl append path: flock is taken before read-modify-write and released before close via LIFO defers; the torn-tail branch preserves the fragment under .metareview/runs/.torn before truncating to t.offset; the newline-less-but-decodable branch prepends a separator instead of corrupting the last row; append is idempotent by id and errors (ERR_RUNS_JSONL id_conflict) on a conflicting head or workflow hash rather than silently skipping.
Exclude of docs/metareview/shards keeps committed shard results out of post-merge learning input; scoping uses both the dir and the ** glob.
Sharded-review docs match the CLI flags added (--shard-result repeatable, --cross-shard-result once) and state the result filename contract.
Durable-vs-transient artifact guidance updated consistently with CLAUDE.md: results committed under docs/metareview/shards/, .metareview/shards/ stays local.
No TODO/FIXME markers, no eval or other unsafe execution, and no truncated chunks anywhere in this shard: every chunk in the pack table is part 1/1.
